subject: maths
question: A borrows an amount of ₹3,600 from B at a rate of 20% simple interest for 2 years and lends 75% of this amount to C at 20% compound interest for 2 years. A uses the remaining amount for his personal purpose. Find the total loss incurred by A.
solution:
**Given:**

Principal borrowed by A from B = ₹3,600

Rate of interest charged by B on loan = 20% per year (simple interest)

Time for which A borrowed from B = 2 years

A lent 75% of the borrowed amount to C at a rate of 20% per year (compound interest) for 2 years

A used the remaining amount for personal purposes

**Formula used:**

Simple Interest (SI) = P × R × T / 100

Compound Interest (CI) = P × [ (1 + R/100)T - 1 ]

Total interest = CI - SI

Where,

P = principal amount

R = rate of interest per annu
